protocol.serious_regressions: disqualify original commit; no repair credit
protocol.freeze: Only after production component RED and passing controls; issue cannot change thereafter
protocol.blinding: Identical symptom-only prompt; oracle and issue analysis excluded from arm directories

lenses.correction: Mount AppRoot and actual ChatView; preserve remount and focus owner behavior; modal control.
Fake only transport; DOM clicks A B A; assert initial focus before switch; reject setup failures as RED.
Source-only control; fixed source tree and budgets; random sequential order; original candidate immutable evaluation.
Disposable pinned checkout, task-local dependencies, no live data or services, sequential bounded indexes, no global config.

protocol.review_independence: Four documented perspectives applied by coordinator; not four independent reviewers

undelivered_common_prompt: Fix the web focus bug: with a terminal visible in thread A, focus the composer, switch to thread B, then return to A. Restore the previously focused control: composer stays composer, terminal stays terminal. Do not steal modal focus. Make a minimal TypeScript/React patch, create a failing-first regression using production components, self-review, run focused browser tests and relevant lint/typechecks plus git diff --check, then commit locally. No push, PR, merge, deployment, global config changes, live data, or unrelated worktree access. Use only this worktree. Fixed coding budget 1080 seconds. Navigation instructions are supplied separately and are the sole treatment difference.

navigation.source-only: Source, rg and tests; no graph.
navigation.afterimage: Own read-only structural CLI queries before editing; source verification. No search, index or watcher during coding.
navigation.gitnexus: Own read-only structural CLI queries before editing; source verification. No analyze or watcher during coding.
